comment: Source read at commit 21bfcbf, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.0. Input index 0 is the C weight and index 1 is the pitch In, so the index order is not the panel order; index 12 is the B weight and index 2 the C sharp weight. A weight CV does not merely override its knob, it writes the value into the knob with setValue (WeightedQuantizer.cpp:83 and the eleven like it), so the knob visibly follows the cable and keeps the last value when the cable is pulled. With every weight at zero the module short-circuits input to output (line 164).
